verses.1: Do not cry on that day, for you will not know what will be born that day.
verses.2: May the stranger praise you, and not a foreigner. And may your lips speak nothing evil.
verses.3: It destroys the wood, and takes away the branches; like the anger of a wild boar, it is terrifying.
verses.4: How cruel and cruel is this behavior! Who can stand before such jealousy?
verses.5: Goodness is revealed from love that is free from any restrictions.
verses.6: Let us heal the wounds of love, and let weeping be silenced.
verses.7: A soul that is hungry, a soul that is thirsty, and a soul that is full of hunger—all these are signs of death.
verses.8: Like a lost bird that flees from its nest, so too does a man who leaves his own place.
verses.9: Wine and spices bring joy to the heart, and they also help to calm one’s mind.
verses.10: Your enemy and your father’s enemy: do not enter their homes on the day of your judgment. It is better to stay far away from them.
verses.11: Be wise, my son; let my heart rejoice, and I will rest in peace.
verses.12: Arum saw evil hidden in the shadows. Suddenly, they were punished.
verses.13: Take it away, for it is a foreign city, and its inhabitants are enemies.
verses.14: He blesses his enemy with a loud voice in the morning. Such curses should be considered as an insult to him.
verses.15: Delph Torad was killed on the day of Saggirin. And Eshet Midyan was also killed.
verses.16: Her hair is like wind; her right hand holds the incense.
verses.17: In iron, together; and each person alone, facing their enemy.
verses.18: The offspring of Tena will eat her fruits, and she will keep her homes safe.
verses.19: Just as the waters flow back to their sources, so too does the human heart flow back to its original state.
verses.20: Shaul will not be saved; his eyes will not be healed. And human beings’ eyes will not be healed either.
verses.21: He values money and gold, and each person is valued according to their worth.
verses.22: If you try to catch the fox in the den within the hills, then do not let it get away from you.
verses.23: I will know your face; your heart will be filled with sorrow.
verses.24: For there is no eternal forgiveness; it must be redeemed from generation to generation.
verses.25: They plowed the fields, and there were many trees and plants on the hills.
verses.26: As a covering for your skin, and as a protection for your field.
verses.27: And let the milk of camels be used as food for your children, and as life for your daughters.
